zh.title: Gulfstream 首架全配備 G400 完成機艙飛行測試
zh.summary: 首架全配備 G400 飛行測試 2小時46分 達48,000呎
body: Gulfstream 已開始對首架配備完整乘客艙的 G400 進行飛行測試，邁向認證的又一步驟。
該架飛機從 Dallas Love Field (DAL) 起飛，飛行 2 小時 46 分鐘，最高爬升至 48,000 英呎。
另一架 G400 在前往 NBAA-BACE 展覽途中創下邁阿密至拉斯維加斯速度紀錄，4 小時 8 分鐘以平均馬赫 0.89 完成，並使用永續航空燃料混合物。
Gulfstream 總裁 Mark Burns 指出：「The aircraft continues to perform exceptionally well as we advance through the rigorous certification program.」

en.title: Gulfstream begins flight test of first fully outfitted G400 cabin
en.summary: First fully outfitted G400 flies 2h46m to 48,000 ft from Dallas Love Field
body: Gulfstream has started flight‑testing the first G400 fitted with a complete passenger cabin, moving closer to certification.
The aircraft departed Dallas Love Field (DAL) for a 2‑hour‑46‑minute flight reaching 48,000 ft.
Another G400 set a Miami–Las Vegas speed record en route to the show, completing the trip in 4 hours 8 minutes at an average Mach 0.89 using a blend of sustainable aviation fuel.
Gulfstream President Mark Burns said: “The aircraft continues to perform exceptionally well as we advance through the rigorous certification program.”
